raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "picosdk" %}
{% set version = "1.1" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.io/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/picosdk-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b6dc68f3a1ae6f044421bf728b8b6f38145403607006e9c014705559d914d6f1

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - flit-core
    - python >=2.7
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=2.7
    - numpy >=1.12.1

test:
  imports:
    - picosdk
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip

about:
  home: https://www.picotech.com
  summary: PicoSDK Python Wrappers
  license: ISC
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - untzag
    - ksunden
